edges.reason: msg.sender flows into the internal _transfer path through public transfer entrypoints.
msg.sender receives the entire minted supply in the constructor.
tx.origin is used as the key for the per-block purchase delay state write.
tx.origin is read inside _transfer anti-bot transfer delay logic.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the buyback swap deadline.
block.timestamp is emitted in the OwnerForcedSwapBack event.
_transfer computes fees using mul/div arithmetic over the amount.
The transfer amount parameter feeds the fee multiplication/division.
The transfer amount is reduced by the computed fees before the final transfer.
The computed fee value is subtracted from the amount.
_transfer triggers swapBack when swap conditions are satisfied.
swapBack calls the private swapTokensForEth helper.
swapTokensForEth performs the router fee-on-transfer token swap.
swapBack distributes ETH to dev and marketing wallets through low-level calls.
Low-level ETH transfers can reenter swapBack while it is still executing.
A reentrant payout recipient can re-enter the token transfer logic.
The router swap moves this token and calls back into _transfer during swapBack.
_transfer writes the per-address last transfer block for anti-bot enforcement.
The anti-bot state write updates _holderLastTransferTimestamp.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read to enforce one purchase per block.
swapBack reads and resets the accumulated dev token buckets.
swapBack reads and resets the accumulated marketing token bucket.
_transfer accumulates per-dev token fee amounts using fee splits.
_transfer accumulates the marketing token fee amount.
_transfer reads buyTotalDevFees to compute buy-side fees.
_transfer reads sellTotalDevFees to compute sell-side fees.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balances.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
swapping guard is set and cleared around the swapBack call inside _transfer.
_transfer gates early transfers on tradingActive.
_transfer gates limit/anti-bot logic on limitsInEffect.
_transfer checks gasLimitActive against the gas price limit for snipers.
_transfer gates the per-block transfer delay on transferDelayEnabled.
_transfer classifies sender/recipient using automatedMarketMakerPairs.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee application.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for limit bypass.
